title: Pranayatheeram
desc: A ghazal singer and a taxi driver form a close bond over the mutual tragedies in their lives. Soon, they meet two young lovers who belong to different faiths and try to bring them together.

title: Alangu
desc: While trying to cross over to Kerala, a Tamil tribal boy and his group of friends get drawn into communal clashes that erupt along the state border.

title: Aathi
desc: A young boy moves to Chennai for his education where he meets a girl and falls in love with her. Soon, they learn that they are both on a mission to avenge the death of their parents.

title: Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi
desc: Arjun, a gangster, learns that a terrorist wants to take revenge from his mother, who is an IPS officer. In order to protect her, he strives to overcome all the odds.

title: Singam II
desc: Durai Singam, a policeman working an undercover operation, attempts to eliminate a drug trafficking ring in the coastal town of Thoothukudi.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Aadikeshava
desc: Following the death of his biological father, a man travels to Rayalaseema to protect his sister and his ancestral temple.
